original_abstract.text: Kernelized attention methods, which aim to replace the $O(N^2)$ complexity of softmax attention with $O(N)$ alternatives, have been the focus of intense research in the last five years. Despite growing interest, systematic evaluations and fair comparisons across approaches and scales are still missing. We analyze kernelized attention in two halves and highlight prominent limitations on each. On efficiency, FlashAttention achieves lower memory consumption and faster wall-clock time than SOTA kernelized methods during training and in vision transformers across most sequence lengths (with inference-time memory in causal language models the only clear exception), contradicting the core assumption for pure kernelized attention used as a drop-in replacement for softmax. We also discover that reported efficiency gains often fail to reproduce against modern baselines. On quality, current kernelized methods leave gaps of 2-10 points relative to softmax under a unified distillation protocol, and model scala alone does not close these gaps. We show this gap is not intrinsic to kernelization: LARA++, a principled extension of LARA that approximates softmax via importance sampling with adaptive proposal distributions, recovers up to 99% of softmax accuracy. We establish that the gap is closable; however, the computational overhead remains substantial, leaving the efficiency wall intact. Code is available at https://github.com/firatoncel/KernelRealityCheckNeurIPS2026
original_abstract.source_title: The Kernel Reality Check: Benchmarking and Distilling Efficient Attention at Scale

en.text: This benchmark separates the runtime and quality claims of kernelized attention. Across most tested sequence lengths, FlashAttention remains faster and uses less training memory; causal-language-model inference memory is the clear exception. Under unified distillation, existing kernel methods retain quality gaps, while adaptive importance-sampling LARA++ recovers up to 99% of softmax accuracy but keeps substantial compute overhead. For CTR architecture selection, the takeaway is to compare measured latency, memory and quality against optimized attention under matched conditions.

zh.text: 这项基准把核化注意力的运行效率和模型质量分开检验。在多数测试长度上，FlashAttention 的训练速度和显存表现更好；因果语言模型的推理显存是明确的例外。统一蒸馏下，现有核方法仍有质量差距，采用自适应重要性采样的 LARA++ 可恢复最高 99% 的 softmax 准确率，但计算开销仍大。选择 CTR 架构时，应在一致条件下与优化后的注意力实现比较实际延迟、显存和质量。

original_abstract.text: Generative recommendation (GR) inference differs substantially from conventional LLM serving, featuring long input sequences, wide beam search, and only a few fixed output tokens. Existing LLM serving engines such as vLLM process beams as batched independent sequences, causing redundant KV cache accesses over the shared prompt prefix. Furthermore, vLLM executes each beam search generation step as a separate engine invocation, incurring host-side beam processing overhead between decoding steps and substantial runtime KV block management in PagedAttention. Using Tree Attention, we concatenate beams along the sequence dimension to eliminate redundant KV accesses, and further optimize execution through pre-generated partial-attention masks, static KV cache allocation, loop-unrolled generation dispatch, TorchAir graph compilation, automatic operator fusion, and vocabulary-constrained decoding. Without the use of custom kernels, our approach reduces end-to-end latency by up to 25x over vLLM on Ascend NPUs, and achieves generation latency comparable to a SOTA solution using custom kernels, showing that the generation pipeline should be optimized holistically before resorting to custom kernel development.
original_abstract.source_title: Optimize the Cob, Then the Kernel: Optimizing Beam Search for Generative Recommendation Inference

en.text: This work optimizes wide-beam generative recommendation as a complete inference pipeline. Tree attention shares prompt KV access across beams; precomputed masks, static cache allocation, unrolled dispatch, graph compilation and constrained decoding reduce runtime overhead. Without custom kernels, experiments on Ascend NPUs report up to 25x lower end-to-end latency than vLLM and latency comparable to a specialized-kernel solution. The result motivates evaluating scheduling and shared-context reuse before adding kernel complexity; the reported speedup is hardware- and baseline-specific.

zh.text: 这项工作把宽束生成式推荐的解码流程整体优化：树状注意力让多条候选路径共享提示词的键值缓存访问，再用预生成掩码、静态缓存、展开调度、图编译和受限解码减少运行时开销。在昇腾 NPU 上，无需自定义算子，端到端延迟相对 vLLM 最高缩短 25 倍，并接近专用算子方案。可借鉴的是先检查调度和共享上下文复用；倍数只适用于论文的硬件与基线。

original_abstract.text: Sparse attention reduces computation, but distributed execution may still transfer unnecessary data and incur substantial per-operation overhead. Mask-aware assignment and scheduling can reduce these costs, but replanning for dynamic masks must be cheaper than the execution time it saves. We present DexAttention, a distributed sparse attention system that co-designs fast online planning with persistent execution. Its assigner uses GPU-accelerated, topology-aware clustering to balance computational load and reduce communication. A lightweight greedy scheduler orders coarse communication and computation operations, while a persistent kernel on each GPU enforces fine-grained dependencies and dispatches ready tasks. This division keeps detailed synchronization out of planning while enabling overlap without repeated attention launches. The framework supports static and dynamic per-head masks across multiple attention compute kernels. On a four-node, 16-GPU cluster, DexAttention achieves a $1.39\times$ geometric-mean end-to-end training speedup over the fastest applicable baseline across 11 configurations. For dynamic video attention, it achieves $2.11$--$2.37\times$ speedups over Ring Attention including planning.
original_abstract.source_title: DexAttention: Distributed Sparse Attention through Rapid Online Planning and Persistent GPU Execution

en.text: DexAttention combines topology-aware GPU clustering, a lightweight scheduler and persistent GPU kernels to execute distributed sparse attention. Fast planning balances load and communication for changing masks, while kernels enforce fine-grained dependencies. On a four-node, 16-GPU cluster it reports a 1.39x geometric-mean end-to-end training speedup over the fastest applicable baseline across 11 configurations. The engineering insight for sparse ranking is that scheduling must cost less than the work it saves; recommendation results are not established.

zh.text: DexAttention 用考虑互连拓扑的 GPU 聚类分配任务，再以轻量调度器和常驻内核执行分布式稀疏注意力，适应不断变化的掩码并减少通信。在四节点、16 张 GPU 的 11 种配置中，相对各配置最快的适用基线，端到端训练加速的几何平均为 1.39 倍。对稀疏排序的工程启发是让规划开销低于它节省的计算与通信；论文尚未验证推荐收益。

original_abstract.text: Multimodal generative recommendation with discrete semantic identifiers (SIDs) requires distinguishing historical modalities that merely alter token predictions from those that genuinely reduce catalog-level ambiguity. When audiovisual, visual, or textual streams are missing, degraded, or semantically conflicting, uniform fusion and unconstrained token gates can propagate misleading content across iterative denoising steps. We propose CONCORD-Rec, a reliability-conditioned discrete diffusion recommender supervised by counterfactual catalog-partition utility. Given a fixed tokenizer and a partially masked SID state, CONCORD-Rec evaluates out-of-fold teacher coalitions over the exact feasible catalog support and aggregates item posteriors across the target code partition at each unresolved position. Rather than distilling raw token probabilities directly, the resulting counterfactual loss differences supervise an availability-masked tokenwise gate that allocates bounded modality residuals around a behavioral denoiser while retaining an exact behavioral fallback slot. We establish theoretical fixed-support ranking stability bounds under gate perturbations and evaluate position-level and code-conditional allocation across audiovisual and image-text recommendation benchmarks under controlled missingness, signal degradation, and semantic conflict. Across 20 source-compatible protocol-dataset rows, CONCORD-Rec improves NDCG by 4%; under matched 30% conflict it improves NDCG by 14.63%. The full-vs-uniform-T=16 sweep improves quality by 2.00-3.58% while reducing p95 latency by up to 86.89%.
original_abstract.source_title: CONCORD-Rec: Catalog-Conditioned Modality Utility for Semantic-ID Diffusion Recommendation

en.text: CONCORD-Rec uses counterfactual utility over feasible catalog partitions to supervise modality gates in a semantic-ID diffusion recommender. Bounded modality residuals augment a behavioral denoiser, with an explicit behavioral fallback when content is unreliable. The abstract reports ranking improvements under missing, degraded and conflicting modalities, plus quality-latency gains in a controlled decoding sweep. For scalable recommendation, the useful idea is to allocate multimodal information by its contribution to candidate discrimination rather than by token changes alone.

zh.text: CONCORD-Rec 在语义 ID 扩散推荐中，用反事实比较衡量各模态能否帮助区分有效候选，并据此训练模态门控。内容信号只作有界补充，不可靠时可退回行为模型。摘要报告了模态缺失、退化和冲突条件下的排序改善，以及受控解码实验中的质量与延迟收益。可借鉴的是按候选区分能力分配多模态信息，而不只看词元预测是否变化。

original_abstract.text: Kernel Ridge Attention (KRA) is a recurrent sequence mixer that combines learned nonlinear features with covariance-guided memory updates. It stores associations through recursive ridge regression, using correlations among past keys to determine how new observations modify memory. A content-dependent Ornstein--Uhlenbeck transition controls retention and restores uncertainty for future writes. This construction admits an exact temporal-kernel interpretation and maintains an inference state whose size is independent of context length. Associative block maps and explicit adjoints support parallel training while preserving the recursive update. In controlled language-modeling experiments, KRA improves prediction quality over attention and recurrent baselines, strengthens natural associative recall over the evaluated recurrent models, and achieves practical distributed training throughput. These properties provide a principled foundation for nonlinear, adaptive sequence memory.
original_abstract.source_title: Kernel Ridge Attention: Nonlinear Memory with Selective Forgetting

en.text: Kernel Ridge Attention stores nonlinear associations through recursive ridge regression, using past-key covariance to guide updates and a content-dependent retention process to selectively forget. Its inference state is independent of context length, while associative block maps enable parallel training. Controlled language-model experiments report stronger prediction and associative recall than the evaluated baselines with practical distributed throughput. It suggests a fixed-memory sequence mixer worth testing for long user histories; CTR performance has not been demonstrated.

zh.text: Kernel Ridge Attention 用递归岭回归保存非线性关联，由历史键的协方差决定如何写入，并按内容选择保留或遗忘。推理状态大小不随上下文长度增长，分块组合则支持并行训练。受控语言模型实验报告了预测质量、关联召回和分布式吞吐表现。它提供了一种适合探索长用户历史的固定容量记忆结构，尚未验证 CTR 收益。

original_abstract.text:
Modern industrial recommender systems use multi-stage cascades--retrieval, pre-ranking, ranking, and re-ranking--to narrow millions of candidates to a personalized list. While each stage deploys sophisticated models, pipeline-level decisions on channel activation, quotas, model selection, and score fusion remain engineer-tuned and user-agnostic within each scenario.
  This report presents MARS (Multi-stage Agentic Recommendation System), extending personalization from individual-stage predictions to full pipeline orchestration. A near-line agent built on fine-tuned Qwen3-0.6B generates per-user configurations--a seven-dimensional action covering pipeline mode, retrieval quotas, model selection, fusion weights, and reranker settings--from a constrained action space. Configurations are validated, cached, and consumed asynchronously; the cascade never waits for LLM inference. Schema checks, fallbacks, and a kill switch ensure serving safety.
  The policy is trained in three stages: Confidence-aware SFT distills schema-valid generation from a teacher model; Format-Anchored Preference Optimization (FAPO) learns action preferences via ActionMask with posterior weighting; Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) refines the policy through Sandbox replay with a frozen reward model, without exposing exploratory actions to live traffic.
  Two-week A/B tests across five Taobao scenarios with over ten million daily users show positive gains on all key metrics. The largest reach +5.22% V2P and +7.34% GMV, with positive CTR lifts on both click surfaces. About 20% of requests use a lightweight Minimal mode, and deployment shows 12 ms lower mean serving latency versus production.

en.text: MARS uses a near-line Qwen3-0.6B agent to choose per-user retrieval quotas, pipeline modes, models, fusion weights and reranking settings. Validated configurations are cached and consumed asynchronously, keeping agent inference off the online critical path. Supervised distillation, preference optimization and sandbox policy training support the agent. Two-week tests across five Taobao scenarios report positive business metrics and 12 ms lower mean serving latency. The CTR-scaling lesson is to allocate pipeline compute per user while preserving validation and fallback paths.

zh.text: MARS 用近线 Qwen3-0.6B 智能体为用户选择召回配额、流水线模式、模型、融合权重和重排设置。配置经校验后缓存并异步使用，在线请求无需等待智能体推理；训练结合监督蒸馏、偏好优化和沙箱策略训练。五个淘宝场景的两周实验报告了业务指标改善和平均服务延迟降低 12 毫秒。可借鉴的是按用户分配整条推荐链路的计算预算，并保留校验与回退路径。

original_abstract.text: Scaling laws are widely used to predict foundation model performance and guide compute allocation. However, tabular foundation models (TFMs) differ from conventional foundation models in that they are pretrained on virtually unlimited synthetic data from configurable distributions, while ultimately being evaluated on real-world datasets. We investigate whether scaling laws for TabPFNv2-style models reliably extrapolate to larger compute budgets and generalize across evaluation settings. Our analysis reveals differences between synthetic and real-world scaling behavior and shows that accurately fitting a scaling law does not necessarily yield reliable prescriptions on unseen datasets. In particular, selecting configurations using too few evaluation datasets leads to systematically over-optimistic performance estimates. We further demonstrate that compute-optimal scaling requires expanding the range of synthetic pretraining dataset sizes alongside model size and training compute. Increasing the maximum numbers of rows and features sampled during pretraining improves performance and produces more predictable scaling trends. These insights guide the training of more efficient TabPFNv2-like models, using the open-source training pipeline of nanoTabPFN.
original_abstract.source_title: Towards Reliable Scaling Laws for Tabular Foundation Models

en.text: This study examines whether scaling laws for TabPFNv2-style models extrapolate across compute budgets and real-world datasets. Good fits on synthetic data do not ensure reliable prescriptions, and selecting with too few evaluation datasets gives optimistic estimates. Expanding synthetic training ranges in both rows and features alongside model size improves scaling predictability. For CTR scaling, the transferable caution is to validate allocation rules across representative datasets; this is tabular-model evidence, not a measured ranking improvement.

zh.text: 研究检查 TabPFNv2 类表格基座模型的扩展规律，发现合成数据上的良好拟合未必能可靠指导真实数据集上的算力分配，评估数据集过少还会产生乐观估计。随模型和训练预算一起扩大合成样本的行数、特征数范围，可改善表现与扩展趋势的可预测性。对 CTR scaling 的借鉴是用足够有代表性的数据验证预算分配规则；这里的证据来自表格模型，未直接测量排序提升。

original_abstract.text: Accurate click-through rate (CTR) prediction depends on user representations that capture both persistent preferences and recent intent, yet processing extensive behavioral histories for every ranking request is costly under production compute and latency constraints. We present X-split ARGUS, a framework for ad ranking whose history compressor and online ranker are trained end to end. The compressor encodes past interactions into a compact set of tokens that are computed offline and reused across candidates, while the online ranker scores ads through cross-attention to these tokens and representations of recent events. Training combines an autoregressive loss for click feedback with distillation of candidate-specific click logits from a larger teacher that scores each candidate using the uncompressed history. The number of compressed history tokens and the length of recent history can be adjusted to fit serving compute and latency budgets. Offline evaluation shows a 0.81% relative reduction in normalized entropy (NE) compared with the production baseline. Deployment in a large-scale real-time bidding system increases online inference cost by 15% relative to the production baseline. An online A/B test against this baseline yields relative gains of 4.65% in a business metric reflecting the monetary value of conversions generated for advertisers and 2.96% in clicks.
original_abstract.source_title: X-split Argus: Learning Reusable History Tokens for Efficient CTR Prediction

en.text: X-split ARGUS jointly trains an offline history compressor and an online ad ranker. Reusable history tokens are combined with recent events through cross-attention, with click-feedback supervision and distillation from a teacher using uncompressed history. The abstract reports a 0.81% relative normalized-entropy reduction, 4.65% improvement in advertiser conversion value, and 2.96% more clicks versus production, alongside 15% higher online inference cost. It offers a concrete history-capacity and serving-budget trade-off for CTR scaling.

zh.text: X-split ARGUS 联合训练离线历史压缩器和在线广告排序器，把长期行为压成可跨候选复用的词元，再与近期行为做交叉注意力。训练结合点击监督和未压缩历史教师的蒸馏。相对生产基线，摘要报告归一化熵降低 0.81%、广告主转化价值指标提升 4.65%、点击数提升 2.96%，同时在线推理成本增加 15%。它提供了在历史容量与服务预算之间取舍的具体方案。

original_abstract.text: Hybrid attention models combine full and linear attention to achieve a better quality--efficiency trade-off. Converting pretrained Transformers into such models requires identifying which layers should retain full attention under a prescribed budget. We identify two off-policy mismatches in FlashMorph's layer selection: (i) continuous branch interpolation and teacher-forced hidden states differ from discrete hybrid computation; and (ii) frozen model weights fail to account for parameter adaptation during subsequent recovery. We introduce FlashMorph2, an on-policy layer-selection method that (I) evaluates sampled discrete hybrid architectures end to end using their own hidden states, and (II) jointly optimizes layer-selection scores and model weights under the recovery objective to reflect post-adaptation performance. Experiments across Qwen3 model scales and linear-attention variants show that FlashMorph2 consistently outperforms existing layer-selection methods, improving average scores over FlashMorph by $+2.42$ points on RULER, $+1.08$ on LongBench, and $+0.76$ on recall-intensive tasks, while completing layer selection in only $0.72$--$3.57$ GPU hours across 0.6B--8B models, demonstrating high efficiency and scalability.
original_abstract.source_title: On-Policy Morphing into Hybrid Attention Models

en.text: FlashMorph2 selects full-versus-linear attention layers by evaluating sampled discrete hybrid models on their own hidden states while jointly adapting weights. This aligns selection with the subsequent recovery objective. Across Qwen3 scales and linear-attention variants, average gains over FlashMorph are 2.42 RULER points, 1.08 LongBench points and 0.76 points on recall-intensive tasks; selection takes 0.72–3.57 GPU hours for 0.6B–8B models. The design suggests evaluating hybrid ranking architectures after adaptation rather than relying on frozen proxies.

zh.text: FlashMorph2 在采样得到的离散混合模型上选择哪些层保留完整注意力，并同时调整权重，让选择过程更接近恢复训练后的实际表现。Qwen3 多种规模和线性注意力变体的实验中，相对 FlashMorph，RULER、LongBench 和重召回任务平均分别提高 2.42、1.08 和 0.76 分；0.6B–8B 模型的选择阶段耗时 0.72–3.57 GPU 小时。可借鉴的是按适应训练后的表现选择混合架构，推荐场景仍需单独验证。

original_abstract.text: In long-context decoding, GPU memory (HBM) caps how many requests a GPU decodes at once. Sparse-attention models such as Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, DeepSeek V4.1-Flash and GLM-5.2 add an indexer: at every step it scores all past index entries with its own indexer cache, and attention reads the main KV of only the top-k entries. We find that once serving systems move the main KV to host memory, the indexer cache becomes the HBM bottleneck, at 63% of per-request HBM on Qwen and 75% on V4.1 at 1M tokens. Therefore, we introduce Twindex, which keeps only a compact copy of the indexer cache in HBM and the full indexer cache in host memory. At each step, the copy selects a larger candidate set, and the model's own indexer picks the top-k from the original rows of the candidates in host memory. The copy combines the shared component with the compressed residuals, both learned once offline. Twindex changes no model weights and runs inside CUDA graphs. At 1M tokens on modern GPUs, Twindex fits $1.78\times$, $1.62\times$ and $3.03\times$ as many requests as KV offloading alone on Qwen, V4.1 and GLM-5.2, and reaches $1.44\times$, $1.25\times$ and $2.54\times$ decode throughput when host memory does not limit the batch. Every request keeps its own index, and Qwen and GLM requests share prefix main KV in host memory. In our evaluations, mean benchmark scores are at most 3.1% below the baseline's.
original_abstract.source_title: Twindex: Index Cache Offloading with Coarse-to-Fine Selection for Long-Context Sparse-Attention Serving

en.text: Twindex keeps a compact indexer-cache copy on GPU and the full cache in host memory. Coarse selection narrows candidates before the model's original indexer selects exact rows from that subset, without changing model weights. At one million tokens, reported decode throughput improves by 1.25–2.54x across three models when host memory does not cap batch size, with mean benchmark scores at most 3.1% below baseline. It illustrates a memory-quality tradeoff for two-stage long-history retrieval, not established CTR gains.

zh.text: Twindex 把完整索引缓存放在主机内存，GPU 只保留压缩副本：先粗选候选，再用模型原有索引器从候选的原始行中精选，无需修改模型权重。百万 token 条件下，主机内存不限制批大小时，三个模型的解码吞吐提高 1.25–2.54 倍，平均基准得分最多比基线低 3.1%。它展示了两阶段长历史检索的内存与质量取舍，尚不能据此判断 CTR 收益。

original_abstract.text: Generative retrieval (GR) for sequential recommendation compresses each item into a short semantic ID and trains an autoregressive decoder to generate next-item codes from a user history. While appealing for cold-start handling and storage, au- toregressive GR suffers a structural scaling limit: typically, longer semantic IDs reduce quantization error in principle but degrade ranking quality and quadratic memory usage against semantic ID length. We propose Late Quantization (LQ), a non-autoregressive paradigm that confines discretization to the output (item) side of the pipeline. The encoder and scoring rule operate in continuous space, while items are stored and matched as semantic IDs produced by an end-to-end-trained residual quantizer. This architectural shift permits an additive error decomposition and a pairwise ordering theorem that jointly bound the quantization- induced ranking drop, a structural guarantee absent in prior semantic-ID recommenders. Across four public benchmarks, the resulting recommender, LQ-Rec, delivers three capabilities simultaneously: ranking quality improves monotonically with the semantic-ID length and outperforms existing baselines; a single trained model supports anytime compression, tuning ranking quality against inference cost without retraining; and LQ-Rec shows superior generalization on a memorization/generalization partition.
original_abstract.source_title: LQ-Rec: Late Quantization for Sequential Recommendation

en.text: LQ-Rec keeps sequence encoding and scoring continuous and quantizes only the item side into semantic IDs, avoiding autoregressive code generation. Its error decomposition and pairwise ordering analysis connect quantization to ranking loss. Across four public benchmarks, longer IDs improve quality, and one model supports different compression budgets without retraining. The transferable idea is to decouple representation learning from storage precision when scaling recommendation retrieval.

zh.text: LQ-Rec 保留连续空间中的序列编码和打分，只把物品侧压成语义 ID，省去逐段生成 ID 的自回归过程。误差分解和成对排序分析把量化误差与排序损失联系起来。四个公开基准中，更长 ID 带来更好的排序质量，同一模型还能在不重训的情况下调整压缩预算。可借鉴的是将表征学习与存储精度分开设计，让召回容量扩展有更清晰的质量与成本取舍。

original_abstract.text: Modern recommendation systems face substantial memory pressure, largely from the sparse embedding layer that maps high-cardinality categorical features into dense vectors. In-training embedding pruning (ITEP) removes less important embedding rows during training, yielding end-to-end memory savings but sometimes degrading accuracy because per-table pruning ratios are set by size-based heuristics. We use feature importance (FI) to guide these ratios (FI-ITEP), assigning higher pruning to tables tied to less important features. Across three large-scale recommendation models, FI-ITEP achieves 20--40% total memory reduction while matching or improving accuracy relative to percentile-based ITEP. Because the feature-importance signal requires minimal resources to compute, these memory savings translate into concrete systems benefits: the same models train on fewer GPU trainers (e.g., 112 to 80) with higher per-GPU throughput, saving 1,000+ GPU-hours per model launch. We reproduce these trends on the open-source DLRM (Criteo 1TB) and quantify the end-to-end training-time and GPU-cost tradeoff---including the burden of computing FI---offering practical guidance for embedding pruning in real-world systems.
original_abstract.source_title: Intelligent Embedding Pruning for Large-Scale Recommendation Models

en.text: FI-ITEP assigns embedding-table pruning ratios using feature importance instead of table-size heuristics. Across three large-scale recommendation models, it reports 20–40% total memory reduction while matching or improving accuracy relative to percentile-based ITEP; one training configuration drops from 112 to 80 GPUs. The study also evaluates DLRM on Criteo 1TB and accounts for feature-importance computation. This offers a practical way to expand recommendation capacity within memory and training-cost budgets.

zh.text: FI-ITEP 用特征重要性决定各嵌入表的剪枝比例，让较不重要的特征承担更多裁减。三个大规模推荐模型的总内存减少 20%–40%，准确率达到或超过按百分位剪枝的 ITEP；一组训练配置由 112 张 GPU 降至 80 张。论文还在 Criteo 1TB 的 DLRM 上复现趋势，并计入重要性计算开销。它为受内存和训练成本约束的推荐扩模提供了可操作的容量分配方法。

original_abstract.text: A recommendation page is consumed as a whole: the items on it compete for attention and complement one another, so the best page is not simply the individually best items placed side by side. We study whole-page optimization, which selects and orders the items on a page jointly to maximize the score of the page. The number of possible pages grows combinatorially, so good pages must be generated rather than enumerated. Some generative re-ranking methods use the same page-level training signal for every choice in a sampled page. Others imitate target pages built before training, which remain largely fixed as the generator improves. We address both limitations with one local page-level objective, which repeatedly moves the current generator toward pages with higher score. This objective splits exactly into one training target per position, and each target compares candidates at the same partial page by the scores of the complete pages they lead to. Every position therefore learns to choose the item that is better for the whole page, rather than the item that looks best on its own. We call this procedure whole-page policy improvement. On two public datasets, KuaiRand-1K and RL4RS-SeqSlate, which cover multi-objective item selection and constrained ordering, and on an industrial dataset of logged pages, our method outperforms the evaluated generative re-ranking baselines. On a synthetic benchmark with a known optimal page, it also comes closest to the optimum, showing that its improvements come from better whole-page decisions.
original_abstract.source_title: Learning Generative Ranking Policies for Whole-Page Optimization

en.text: Whole-page policy improvement decomposes a local page-level objective into position-specific targets that compare candidates at the same partial page by the complete pages they induce. This trains a generator to account for item competition and complementarity without enumerating all pages. It outperforms evaluated generative reranking baselines on two public datasets and industrial logs. The relevance to ranking scaling is tractable optimization of combinatorial page decisions rather than isolated item scores.

zh.text: 方法把整页优化目标分解为各位置的训练目标：在同一个未完成页面上，比较不同候选最终形成的整页得分。生成器因此能学习物品之间的竞争和互补，无需枚举所有页面组合。在两个公开数据集和工业日志上，结果优于所评估的生成式重排基线。对排序扩展的价值是用可训练的逐位置决策处理组合空间，兼顾整页收益。

original_abstract.text: Long user behavior sequences are among the strongest signals for click-through rate (CTR) prediction. Cross-attention makes these sequences practical for industrial ranking by keeping compute linear in sequence length. Yet the gains from stacking cross-attention layers taper off: on Taobao search, growing a cross-attention stack from 16 to 28 layers adds only 0.02 percentage points (pt) of AUC. We argue that the key-value side is the bottleneck. Each layer projects the same behavior sequence into keys and values, so adding depth gives the model more reads of a fixed sequence. We propose DNA (Dual-stream Nexus Attention), which lets the sequence itself evolve with depth. At each layer, the request representation (the search query, user features and scene) first reads the sequence. Each behavior token then attends to the updated request representation and uses what it reads to update itself, so the next layer reads a sequence shaped by the current request. The update runs once per request, all candidates share the resulting sequence, and both the reads and the update keep linear complexity in sequence length. At comparable forward FLOPs, DNA improves AUC over cross-attention stacks by 0.08 to 0.26 pt and keeps improving in the depth range where those stacks level off. DNA-4 is deployed in Taobao search. In an online A/B test against the production model, it improves CTR by 0.8% and GMV by 0.5%.
original_abstract.source_title: DNA: Unlocking Depth Scaling in CTR Models

en.text: DNA alternates request-to-history reads with history-to-request updates, letting behavior representations evolve with depth while sharing the updated history across candidates. Both operations remain linear in history length. At comparable forward FLOPs, AUC improves by 0.08–0.26 percentage points over cross-attention stacks; the deployed DNA-4 reports 0.8% CTR and 0.5% GMV gains against production. The direct scaling lesson is to increase the expressivity of the shared history as depth grows.

zh.text: DNA 让请求先读取行为历史，再让每个行为 token 根据更新后的请求表示调整自己，下一层因此读到更贴合当前请求的历史。更新后的历史由所有候选共享，计算仍随序列长度线性增长。在前向计算量相近时，相对交叉注意力堆叠，AUC 提高 0.08–0.26 个百分点；上线的 DNA-4 相对生产模型报告 CTR 提高 0.8%、GMV 提高 0.5%。可借鉴的是让共享历史表示随深度演化，减少反复读取固定历史的瓶颈。

original_abstract.text: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly need to process long documents and codebases, making long-context attention a major prefill bottleneck. Block sparse attention reduces computation by skipping unimportant blocks of the attention matrix, but scoring blocks accurately can itself be expensive. We propose Delta-Based Tile Scoring (DTS), a training-free, content-adaptive tile scoring method for sparse block attention. DTS selects query and key anchors according to local vector changes, using fewer representatives in redundant regions while retaining more detail in heterogeneous regions. To accelerate anchor selection, parallel delta packing partitions the query and key sequences into tile-aligned chunks and performs bounded local scans over these chunks concurrently. The selected tiles are then computed using the original query, key, and value vectors. On LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct, DTS keeps average RULER and LongBench scores within 0.10 percentage points of full attention, with RULER evaluated up to 128K tokens. At 128K tokens, DTS reduces measured scoring-pipeline latency by 38% compared with XAttention. On four NVIDIA H100 GPUs, it achieves a 3.3$\times$ prefill speedup over a PyTorch full-attention baseline using FlashAttention-2 at 512K tokens.
original_abstract.source_title: DTS: Delta-Based Tile Scoring for Efficient Long-Context Sparse Attention

en.text: DTS chooses query/key representatives from local vector changes to score sparse-attention tiles, allocating fewer anchors to redundant regions. Parallel chunk-local scans reduce selection overhead, and retained tiles use the original vectors. On LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct, mean RULER and LongBench scores remain within 0.10 percentage points of full attention; at 128K tokens the scoring pipeline is 38% faster than XAttention. The transferable lesson is to budget sparse-selection overhead as carefully as attention computation.

zh.text: DTS 根据相邻向量的变化挑选查询和键的代表点：重复区域少取点，变化较大的区域多保留细节，再据此选择注意力块。分块并行扫描减少选择开销，实际注意力仍使用原始向量。在 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，RULER 与 LongBench 平均分与完整注意力相差不超过 0.10 个百分点；128K token 时，评分流水线延迟比 XAttention 低 38%。对长历史建模的启发是把稀疏选择本身的成本一起纳入预算，推荐效果尚未验证。

original_abstract.text: Personalized content recommendation on large marketplace websites must reconcile heterogeneous candidate content (e.g., customer stories, product pages, industry pages, and learning content) with sparse, fast-changing user behavior, placing increasing demands on the retrieval stage to represent user interest well, not just the downstream ranking stage. We present LSER (LLM Session Embedding Retrieval), a production content recommendation system for autodesk.com that derives session- and history-level embeddings from a pretrained large language model (LLM) and adds them as auxiliary user-side features in the retrieval-stage user tower alongside existing learned sequence encoders. To keep user-side embeddings fresh under real-time behavior, we build a nearline serving path that asynchronously refreshes sequential and LLM-derived user vectors for our main content recommendation server. We validate the incremental value of the LLM features through an ablation study across our full multi-content-type catalog. Our results indicate that integrating LLM-derived embeddings as additional retrieval signals, together with production-grade nearline serving, is technically feasible and can improve model performances.
original_abstract.source_title: From Sessions to Serving: Integrating LLM-Based Embeddings into Retrieval for Production Content Recommendation

en.text: LSER adds pretrained-LLM session and history embeddings to an existing retrieval user tower alongside learned sequence encoders. A nearline path asynchronously refreshes user vectors to incorporate recent behavior. An ablation across the production multi-content catalog supports the incremental value of the LLM features, without numerical gains stated in the abstract. It provides an integration pattern for richer retrieval representations while keeping representation refresh outside the synchronous serving path.

zh.text: LSER 将预训练语言模型生成的会话与历史嵌入，作为额外信号加入现有召回用户塔，并保留原有序列编码器。近线链路异步更新用户向量，使近期行为进入召回表示。生产环境多类型内容目录上的消融支持这些特征的增量价值，摘要未给出具体增幅。可借鉴的是用异步刷新接入更丰富的表示，控制在线请求的计算负担。

original_abstract.text: Mixture of Block Attention (MoBA) reduces long-context computation by selecting key-value (KV) blocks for each query. FlashMoBA implements MoBA efficiently but retains a fixed Top-k budget and query-centric schedule. Fixed Top-k applies one budget across different score distributions and couples routing to task granularity; query-range ownership fragments K/V reuse when several ranges select the same column. We present LightningMoBA, which co-designs selection and execution through dynamic routing, KV-centric ownership, and runtime pipelining. Dynamic routing thresholds MoBA's per-query block scores and directly emits variable-cardinality sparse metadata. KV-centric ownership groups selected rows by (query head, KV block) column, splits high-fanout columns into bounded tasks, and reuses each task's loaded KV tile. On Hopper, pipelining overlaps regular K/V transfers and irregular query gathers with Tensor Core computation. Together, these mechanisms decouple retention from GPU scheduling granularity. At matched Top-16 retention across five checkpoints, LightningMoBA accelerates end-to-end generation by 1.20 to 1.60x while raising mean RULER score from 74.42 to 75.28.
original_abstract.source_title: Accelerating Mixture of Block Attention via Dynamic Routing, KV-Centric Execution and Runtime Pipelining

en.text: LightningMoBA combines score-threshold dynamic block routing, KV-centric task ownership and Hopper runtime pipelining. Grouping work by shared KV blocks improves reuse while bounded tasks handle high fanout. At retention matched to Top-16 across five checkpoints, end-to-end generation accelerates by 1.20–1.60x and mean RULER rises from 74.42 to 75.28. It suggests co-designing sparse attention selection and data reuse for ranking, though the reported evidence is from language models.

zh.text: LightningMoBA 用评分阈值动态选择注意力块，再按共享的键值块组织计算任务，配合 Hopper 上的数据传输与计算流水线提高复用。五个检查点在与 Top-16 相当的保留预算下，端到端生成加速 1.20–1.60 倍，RULER 平均分从 74.42 升至 75.28。可借鉴的是共同设计稀疏选择与数据复用方式；这些结果来自语言模型，不能直接当作排序收益。

original_abstract.text: Attention in large language models (LLMs) scores every query against every key with a full dot product. We investigate whether this dot product must be computed completely for attention to be effective. We propose Hidden Sparse Attention (HiSA), which keeps the query and key projections intact but only computes a partial dot product, following a static, parameter-free rule set by the token positions: attention becomes sparse in the hidden (feature) dimension, an axis much less explored than token sparsity, rather than over tokens as in almost all sparse attention methods. Based on the structure of rotary position embeddings (RoPE), we decompose keys and queries into parts which can be omitted when computing attention. By training LLMs from scratch with HiSA, we find that this partial dot product does not hurt but improves performance compared with the complete product while computing only about a third of the query-key products. During inference HiSA improves decoding speed and shrinks memory footprint. We also extend HiSA to FlashAttention-3 kernels for training and inference. Finally, we motivate our approach by showing that dense attention learns to suppress the attention score parts that HiSA drops. Code is available at https://github.com/ambroise-b/hisa.
original_abstract.source_title: HiSA: Sparsifying the Hidden Dimension of RoPE Attention in LLMs

en.text: HiSA exploits rotary-position structure to omit selected hidden-dimension terms in query-key dot products while leaving the projections intact. A static position-based rule computes about one third of the query-key products; language models trained from scratch improve over the evaluated dense counterparts, with kernel implementations for training and decoding. This introduces feature-dimension sparsity as an additional design axis for scalable attention; recommendation gains have not been demonstrated.

zh.text: HiSA 利用旋转位置编码的结构，在查询与键的点积中省略部分隐藏维度，保留原来的投影层。静态位置规则只计算约三分之一的查询—键乘积；从头训练的语言模型优于所评估的稠密模型，并提供训练与解码内核。它为可扩展注意力增加了沿特征维度做稀疏化的设计方向，推荐任务上的收益仍待验证。

original_abstract.text: Large Web platforms operate large fleets of ranking models, each selecting features from a shared pool of tens of thousands. We present an end-to-end agentic system that optimizes features across the fleet under resource constraints shared across models and those set per model, such as feature pipeline cost and serving throughput (QPS), respectively. In this system, LLM agents propose hypotheses, and deterministic tools execute experiments and verify them. For each model, an LLM generates and shortlists cross features from a combinatorial candidate space, and all features are then ranked by several importance methods. Feature blending mixes these rankings into a single selection, using Pareto fronts across tasks for multi-task models. An LLM Researcher agent then tunes the feature selection in 10--25 asynchronous trials under resource caps, and a trimming step keeps the pipeline cost within budget. Across production models, the system improves normalized entropy by 0.31% on average within each model's budget, and the trimming step cuts pipeline cost by 2.3% with no regression beyond measurement noise. The optimized models were launched, and in online A/B tests they improved a primary online metric by 0.20%.
original_abstract.source_title: Cost-Aware Agentic Feature Optimization System for Fleet-Scale Ranking Models

en.text: This system uses LLM agents to propose cross features and tune feature selection, while deterministic tools run and verify experiments under shared pipeline and per-model serving budgets. Feature rankings are blended, with Pareto fronts for multi-task models and a final cost-trimming step. It reports 0.31% mean normalized-entropy improvement within model budgets, 2.3% lower pipeline cost from trimming, and 0.20% improvement in an unnamed primary online metric. It makes feature and resource allocation part of fleet-scale ranking optimization.

zh.text: 系统由语言模型提出交叉特征与筛选方案，再由确定性工具运行和验证实验，同时约束跨模型的特征流水线成本与单模型服务预算。多种重要性排序经融合后用于选择特征，最后裁减成本。摘要报告预算内平均归一化熵改善 0.31%，裁减使流水线成本降低 2.3%，上线主要指标提高 0.20%，但未说明该指标名称。它把特征选择与资源分配纳入整组排序模型的扩展过程。
